name: Corroding Palm
description: Strike a worn buckle or plate with a palm that eats the metal and leaves it flaking.

name: Flaking Guard
description: Hold up a forearm of crumbling qi that flakes the edge of any blade biting into it.

name: Rot Slip
description: Slip off the line of a cut on a half-step that leaves the foe's blade meeting air.

name: Crack Flick
description: Flick ageing qi at the rim of a shield so the old grain splits open.

name: Plate Corrode
description: Drive entropy qi through plate armour until the straps rot and the metal under them flakes away.

name: Cord Rot
description: Age a binding cord laid on an ally until it frays through and drops away from the limb.

name: Entropy Surge
description: Loose a surge of entropy qi that ages gear and wounds across a wide arc before the user.

name: Ending Release
description: Bring a curse's cycle to its close in an ally so the clinging bane falls out of them.

name: Vital Pinch
description: Pinch the muscle above the knee and pull a thin thread of vitality out of the leg.

name: Sagging Brace
description: Sag into a brace that takes a heavy blow and bleeds its force away through the soles.

name: Ebb Glide
description: Glide away along a falling breath so the foe's reach ends a hand short of the body.

name: Vitality Snap
description: Pull one thread of vitality from the foe's forearm and snap it so the grip breaks.

name: Life Siphon
description: Hold a steady siphon on the foe's vitality so every swing comes slower than the last.

name: Deep Drain
description: Sink the palm to the wrist in a single blow and wring a great draught of strength out of the foe.

name: Venom Ebb
description: Pull venom from a bitten limb into the user's hand and let it rot away there.

name: Vitality Rend
description: Thrust stiffened fingers through the guard and tear a rope of vitality out of the body behind it.

name: Quiet Purge
description: Draw a deep poison or taint out of an ally's blood and let it fade to nothing in the user's palm.

name: Quiescent Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sets a calm over the struck muscle and takes the spring out of it.

name: Fading Shell
description: Close the qi field into a close grey shell that thins every blow that reaches it.

name: Dim Glide
description: Glide on the edge of the field where the qi dims and the body is hard to follow.

name: Lapse Flick
description: Flick a mote of lapsing qi at the foe's eyes so the vision stutters and slows.

name: Pall Touch
description: Rest a hand on the shoulder and let a pall of weariness spread down the arm.

name: Drooping Pall
description: Let the qi field droop over nearby foes so their limbs feel heavy and their steps drag.

name: Waning Aura
description: Radiate an aura of ending that wears at the vitality of everything living within the field.

name: Slackening Hush
description: Fill a small circle with a calm that lets taints and poisons settle out of those within.

name: Cessation Pall
description: Fill the whole field with cessation so each foe within slows and every blow they strike loses weight.

name: Quiet Cleansing
description: Hold the field open over allies so deep taint and backlash sink out of them and end.

name: Twin Wither
description: Strike with both palms in turn so the second wither follows the first into the same spot.

name: Wither Ward
description: Cross both forearms in a ward that doubles the rot laid on any weapon that strikes them.

name: Twinned Fade
description: Take two short steps as one so the foe cannot judge which foot carries the weight.

name: Dual Flick
description: Flick two motes of blight in sequence at the same eye so the second lands in the first's haze.

name: Double Rot
description: Lay two touches of rot on one arm so the weakness doubles and the arm drops.

name: Joint Siphon
description: Draw vitality with both hands from two limbs of the same foe until both slow.

name: Paired Release
description: Rest a hand on each side of an ally and let a sickness leave by one and the strain by the other.

name: Twofold Decay
description: Drive one decay into the body and a second into the first so the rot spreads in a ring.

name: Twin Quiet
description: Hold two points on an ally and let a deep curse and its echo both come to rest.

name: Ashfall Fist
description: Strike with a fist that sheds a grey fall of ash over the point of impact.

name: Soot Shell
description: Draw a shell of sooty qi close about the body to blunt a thrown spear.

name: Ashen Slide
description: Slide through a drift of ash so the foe sees only a grey smear moving.

name: Smother Flick
description: Flick a clod of damp ash that smothers a flame or a gathering qi on touch.

name: Soot Veil
description: Let ash fall thick over the foe's face until the sense of direction fails.

name: Ash Smother
description: Lay a smothering ash over a foe's qi so that it gathers weakly and slowly.

name: Grey Cinderfall
description: Rain hot grey cinders over a small circle of foes so each is burned and weakened.

name: Ash Remedy
description: Dust an ally's wound with consecrated ash that draws a poison up and burns it clean.

name: Pyre Ash Fall
description: Gather the qi field into a great grey cloud and let it fall as ash that weakens all it covers.

name: Rest Ash
description: Let a gentle ash settle on allies so that a binding or a creeping bane turns to powder and falls.

name: Plunge Palm
description: Drop onto a target from a short height and strike downward with a palm.

name: Furled Wing
description: Fold both arms in like wings and take a blow across the forearms and shoulders.

name: Fallen Pinion
description: Spring from the toes and come down light a short way off with arms spread.

name: Withered Talon
description: Flick a sharp splinter of ending qi from the fingers like a claw thrown from the hand.

name: Quiet Grip
description: Seize the shoulder from above and let a quiet weight pull the foe to a knee.

name: Hush Dive
description: Dive on a distracted foe with a silent strike that arrives before the sound of it.

name: Stooping Cut
description: Fall onto the guard from above with a stiffened hand that parts the arms and wounds the chest.

name: Spread Wing Calm
description: Spread both arms and let a settling quiet slow every foe close enough to strike.

name: Feather Touch
description: Brush an ally's brow with a feather-light hand and lift a binding of fear or sorrow-poison from the mind.

name: Last Stoop
description: Plunge from height with the full weight of ending behind one palm that finishes a foe's strength.

name: Settling Hush
description: Come to rest beside a stricken friend and let the quiet draw out a creeping curse.

name: Gust Wither
description: Strike on a gust of air with a palm that shrivels the skin it touches.

name: Windbreak Palm
description: Sweep an arm across the front and carry a thrown missile off on a spent gust.

name: Drifting Pace
description: Drift sideways on a slow breeze with the heels barely brushing the ground.

name: Sour Draft
description: Breathe out a sour draft that sickens the foe a pace away and sets him coughing.

name: Gale Wane
description: Send a failing gale over a foe so the wind goes out of his legs and his swing.

name: Carried Taint
description: Carry a poison out of an ally's breath on a gentle wind and scatter it thin.

name: Withering Draft
description: Send a sweeping withering draft before the user that dries and weakens all it crosses.

name: Sworn Breeze
description: Swear a soft breeze over a friend and let it bear off a curse and a long illness.

name: Dying Palm
description: Strike with a palm gone cold and heavy as a dying hand.

name: Slack Sail
description: Throw a loose sleeve across a thrust like a slack sail that spills the force.

name: Fallen Breeze
description: Step on a breeze that drops away and leave the foe reaching at nothing.

name: Choking Whiff
description: Blow a whiff of stale qi into the foe's face that catches the breath and breaks the rhythm.

name: Gust Die-Off
description: Loose a gust that dies inside the foe's lungs and leaves the chest tight and slow.

name: Cough Ease
description: Ease a choking poison from an ally's chest by drawing a last cool breath out of it.

name: Failing Wind
description: Breathe a failing wind across the foe so every step falls shorter than the one before.

name: Dying Gale
description: Loose a gale that dies as it crosses the foes and leaves each of them hollow and slow.

name: Windborne Release
description: Send a still wind through allies that lifts a lingering curse or taint and bears it off.

name: Breathline Strike
description: Fix a line on the foe's breath and strike straight along it into the chest.

name: Breathline Ward
description: Hold the arms along the line of the foe's attack and let the blow slide down them.

name: Breathline Step
description: Step off the foe's line at a sharp angle and settle onto a new bearing.

name: Breath Mark
description: Mark the foe's chest with a touch that makes each coming breath fall out of rhythm.

name: Thread Flick
description: Flick a thread of ending qi along the marked line at the foe's mouth.

name: Stilled Breath
description: Hold the breath still and turn a blow aside with a smooth stiff forearm.

name: Breath Seizure
description: Seize the rhythm of the foe's breathing along the bearing and lock the chest in place.

name: Windless Press
description: Press the palm into the foe's ribs so every pocket of breath in them goes still.

name: Oathed Ebb
description: Ease a sworn friend's sickness out along the same bearing and let it dissolve in the open air.

name: Ending Thread
description: Drive a narrow thread of ending qi along the bearing straight through the guard.

name: Final Breath
description: Strike on the bearing with the whole weight of ending behind it so the foe's breath stops short.

name: Bearing Release
description: Take a bearing on the root of a curse in an ally and bring it to its quiet end.
